First, note time zones in 1926:  
- Asia/Tokyo: likely JST (UTC+9)  
- Europe/Athens: likely EET (UTC+2) in May (no DST in 1926).  

Difference: UTC+9 to UTC+2 = 7 hours behind Tokyo.  

11 PM (23:00) May 10 in Tokyo → subtract 7 hours:  
23:00 - 7 hours = 16:00 same date May 10.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1926-05-10 16:00
